title: N-able takes its remote access service offline after researcher publishes dozens of zero-day bugs | TechCrunch
summary: Remote access company N-able has confirmed it took down its cloud-hosted offering to fix a slew of security vulnerabilities that were published online this week, giving the company no advance notice to fix them.
